description: Composite figure combining high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) micrographs, inverse-FFT (IFFT) reconstructions and a bar chart, all on Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.5C-xNi-yCr low-density austenitic steels. Panels (a, c, e, g) are HRTEM images taken along the [011]γ zone axis of 3Cr, 2Ni, 2Ni3Cr and 2Ni5Cr steels respectively; each carries a white "10 nm" scale bar at bottom left and a fast Fourier transform (FFT) inset whose reflections are circled in red and labelled 000, 111γ, 200γ, 100LRO, 011LRO. Panels (b, d, f, h) are the corresponding IFFT images reconstructed from the {011} and {100} LRO superlattice reflections, rendered on a dark background with yellow ellipses outlining each domain; domains are visibly largest and most elongated in (d) (2Ni) and smallest in (b) and (h) (3Cr, 2Ni5Cr). Panel (i) is a hatched bar chart of average size/nm (y-axis, 0-11 nm) against the four steels on the x-axis (2Ni, 2Ni3Cr, 2Ni5Cr, 3Cr); the bars fall in that order, from just above the 10 nm gridline for 2Ni down to below 2 nm for 3Cr. Taken together, the panels demonstrate that κ-carbide/LRO domain size increases strongly with Ni and is reduced by Cr addition.
measured_quantities: average domain size of LRO domains / κ-carbides (nm)
domain size distribution counted over >200 domains (count)

observations.observation: Panels (a), (c), (e) and (g) are HRTEM images labelled 3Cr, 2Ni, 2Ni3Cr and 2Ni5Cr respectively, each with a white '10 nm' scale bar at the bottom left.
Each HRTEM panel contains an FFT inset in which reflections are circled in red and labelled with strings 000, 111γ, 200γ, 100LRO and 011LRO.
Panels (b), (d), (f) and (h) are dark-background IFFT images in which each domain is outlined by a yellow ellipse, showing an ellipsoidal, spatially localized morphology.
The yellow-outlined domains are clearly largest in panel (d) (2Ni) and smallest in panels (b) (3Cr) and (h) (2Ni5Cr) at the same 10 nm scale.

Panel (i) is a bar chart with y-axis labelled 'average size/nm' spanning 0 to about 11 and x-axis categories 2Ni, 2Ni3Cr, 2Ni5Cr, 3Cr; the bar heights decrease monotonically in that order, the 2Ni bar reaching just above the 10 gridline and the 3Cr bar lying just below the 2 gridline.
No numerical data labels are printed on the bars of panel (i); values can only be read against the y-axis gridlines.

The caption states that (a, c, e, g) are HRTEM images along the [011]γ zone axis of 3Cr, 2Ni, 2Ni3Cr and 2Ni5Cr steel, respectively, and that (b, d, f, h) are IFFT images of Fig. 3a, c, e and g using {011} and {100} superlattice reflections of LRO domains.
The caption states the average domain sizes are approximately 1.75 nm (3Cr), 2.14 nm (2Ni5Cr), 5.46 nm (2Ni3Cr) and 10.69 nm (2Ni).
The caption labels panel (i) as the average size of the LRO domains or κ-carbides, implying that the domains imaged in 3Cr and 2Ni5Cr are LRO domains whereas those in 2Ni and 2Ni3Cr are κ-carbides.

The citing text states that the microstructures are LRO domains in the 3Cr and 2Ni5Cr steels and κ-carbides in the 2Ni and 2Ni3Cr steels, and that the FFT insets in Fig. 3a, c, e and g are FFT patterns.
The citing text describes the LRO domains in Fig. 3b and 3h as ellipsoidal with a spatially localized, interconnected morphology typical of spinodal decomposition.
The citing text reports sizes decreasing from ~10.69 nm (2Ni) through ~5.46 nm (2Ni3Cr) and ~2.14 nm (2Ni5Cr) to ~1.75 nm (3Cr), measured on more than 200 domains using Image-Pro Plus software.
The citing text concludes that κ-carbide size decreases with increasing Cr content and hypothesizes that Cr hinders, while Ni promotes, κ-carbide/LRO formation.

subfigures.description: HRTEM micrograph of 3Cr steel along the [011]γ zone axis with a mottled, modulated contrast; white 10 nm scale bar bottom-left; FFT inset with red-circled spots labelled 000, 111γ, 200γ, 100LRO, 011LRO.
IFFT reconstruction of (a) (3Cr), dark background with many small yellow-outlined ellipsoidal domains, the smallest of the series; 10 nm scale bar.
HRTEM micrograph of 2Ni steel along [011]γ showing coarse modulated contrast; 10 nm scale bar; FFT inset labelled 000, 111γ, 200γ, 100LRO, 011LRO.
IFFT reconstruction of (c) (2Ni), dark background with large yellow-outlined ellipses up to roughly 10 nm long (κ-carbides); 10 nm scale bar.
HRTEM micrograph of 2Ni3Cr steel along [011]γ; 10 nm scale bar; FFT inset with red-circled reflections labelled 111γ, 200γ, 100LRO, 011LRO, 000.
IFFT reconstruction of (e) (2Ni3Cr), dark background with intermediate-sized yellow-outlined domains; 10 nm scale bar.
HRTEM micrograph of 2Ni5Cr steel along [011]γ; 10 nm scale bar; FFT inset with red-circled superlattice reflections labelled 111γ, 200γ, 100LRO, 011LRO, 000.
IFFT reconstruction of (g) (2Ni5Cr), dark background with many small yellow-outlined ellipsoidal LRO domains; 10 nm scale bar.

Hatched bar chart: y-axis 'average size/nm' from 0 to about 11; four bars on the x-axis labelled 2Ni, 2Ni3Cr, 2Ni5Cr, 3Cr, decreasing monotonically (just above 10 nm for 2Ni, about 5.5 nm for 2Ni3Cr, about 2.1 nm for 2Ni5Cr, about 1.75 nm for 3Cr).
